question: How many auto claims came through each sales channel in Q3 2026?

report.interpretation: Auto claims counted by loss date from 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30 (Q3 2026), grouped by the sales channel of the policy. I used the agreed claim_count metric.
report.answer: In Q3 2026 there were 750 auto claims. Agent: 381. Direct: 226. Online: 143. Partner has none because partner policies are all home policies. The last few weeks of September are incomplete because claims are reported late, so these counts will rise a little.

tool_calls.sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT channel, count(*) AS value
FROM source
WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
  AND product IN ('auto')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL
